#### Are snorers fatter?

```{r normality-bmi-snore}
shapiro.test(snore$bmi[snore$snore == "O"])
shapiro.test(snore$bmi[snore$snore == "N"])
```

Normality of BMI was rejected in both groups (p < 0.05), so snorers and non-snorers were compared with the Mann-Whitney test.

```{r test-bmi-snore}
tapply(snore$bmi, snore$snore, median)
wilcox.test(bmi ~ snore, data = snore)
```

```{r plot-bmi-snore}
ggplot(snore, aes(x = snore, y = bmi)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("N" = "Non-snorers", "O" = "Snorers")) +
  labs(title = "BMI of snorers and non-snorers", x = "", y = "BMI (kg/m²)") +
  theme_bw()
```

Snorers did not have a higher BMI than non-snorers (median 28.1 kg/m² in both groups, Mann-Whitney test, p > 0.05). The data do not confirm the stereotype that snorers are fatter.
